Eileen / team — I reviewed your v3 redlines and the subprocessor export. Summary of our position and proposed edits: 

- SCCs + UK IDTA addendum: Redwood can commit to deploying the EU SCCs for data flows from the EU and will execute the standard UK Addendum (IDTA) for the UK. We prefer not to adopt client-specific "bridging clauses" that deviate materially from the SCC framework because that increases legal and operational risk.

- Section 6 (transfer-impact language): we can accept the spirit of your edit but propose the following compromise language to sit alongside the SCCs: "Where law or binding requests materially constrain the effectiveness of SCCs, the parties will cooperate on mitigation measures and documented technical and contractual safeguards, and Redwood will notify Customer within 72 hours of becoming aware." This keeps SCCs as primary while adding a pragmatic notification and mitigation obligation.

- Evidence & retention for subprocessors: Redwood will provide subprocessor names and the last audit date; for specific audit evidence we can provide summaries (evidence_SAAS-provider-audit-summary.pdf) and will retain supplier assessment records for three years from termination of the supplier relationship. We cannot produce full third-party audit reports without appropriate NDAs in place in some cases — we propose a redacted evidence package instead.

- DocuSign flow & signers: Redwood Legal Ops will issue the DocuSign envelope. Signer will be: Carmen Alvarez, VP Legal, Redwood Inference. Please confirm NovaHealth's counter-signer and whether procurement must also countersign.

I have attached a mark-up (not embedded here) and will prepare a tracked-change Word for acceptance if this position is acceptable.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

- Subprocessor flags: the CSV includes a "sensitivity" column; we've highlighted two vendors (AnalyticsCo and MedStore) that will have access to more detailed metadata. We've reattached the filtered CSV.
- Evidence turnaround: Procurement asks for 5 business days where possible; legal remarks 7 business days acceptable.
- DocuSign: NovaHealth counter-signer will be Rajiv Menon, SVP Procurement & Ops. Procurement would like procurement@novahealth.com included as an additional signer on the envelope so internal PO can flow.

We can accept SCCs + UK addendum as a path forward provided the notification/mitigation language above is included. We'll aim to get internal sign-off and return a countersigned DocuSign link by next week.
